maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: Individual keypoints on both left and right sides are positioned superior and slightly lateral to the primary dense row, maintaining a vertical separation of approximately 1.5 times the diameter of the keypoint itself.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: Approximately 40 percent melanin saturation; dark pixels are heavily concentrated along the lateral margins and the vertical philtrum, with numerous distinct, small-diameter dark clusters (freckles) distributed across the central and superior pink region.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive and dense freckling pattern on the pink apex of the rhinarium.
